data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Bottleneck Identification
features.description: Identify bottlenecks in the pipeline execution process.
acceptance_criteria: Bottlenecks are detected based on predefined criteria.
Reports highlight specific stages causing delays.

features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide actionable recommendations to optimize pipeline performance.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on data analysis findings.
Users receive notifications of new optimization suggestions.
Recommendations include potential impact on performance.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a system to load pipeline execution data into the analysis platform.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully ingested from multiple sources.
Ingestion process is automated and runs on a schedule.
Data integrity is maintained during the ingestion process.

features.title: Visualization of Performance Trends
features.description: Create visualizations to represent pipeline performance trends.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include graphs and charts of key metrics.
Users can interact with and customize the visualizations.
Visualizations update dynamically with new data.

features.title: Performance Metrics Analysis
features.description: Analyze pipeline execution data to evaluate performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics such as execution time and resource usage are calculated.
Analysis identifies trends and anomalies in the data.
Results are stored for further processing and visualization.
